title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-09-06
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Restored version of Grateful Dead portion of source ID 16608; Lineage given in shnid 16608: Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard (No Dolby)->DAT->CD->EAC->SHN->CD->EAC->SHN; corrected the speed, and restored the crispness of the recording with a multifilter (spectral filter, two virtual valve simulators for harmonics, channel blender set to mono below 125Hz)using Diamond Cut Forensics 8.5.

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard restoration delivers crisp audio, highlighted by a laid‑back Friend of Mine and overall high‑energy rocking, though the organ on It’s All Over Now sounds off‑key.
ai_review.review: The recording benefits from an excellent soundboard source and careful restoration, giving a clean and balanced listening experience. Musically the show is a solid rocker with a standout, relaxed rendition of Friend of Mine, but it feels somewhat incomplete and the organ on It’s All Over Now appears out of key, tempering enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews praise the soundboard quality and a strong performance of Friend of Mine while noting an incomplete show and a problematic organ part; overall rating reflects good musical energy with minor flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice sound and solid restoration noted by multiple reviewers; generally clear mix, though one reviewer perceives the organ/keyboards sounding in the wrong key on a specific song.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show feels incomplete and missing some momentum, but retains a rocking vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo described as thick and twangy, complementing the laid‑back feel of Friend of Mine.
band_member_comments.Keys: Nice keys accompany Jerry on Friend of Mine; however organ on It's All Over Now sounds possibly out of key.
